newsitem.title: UK: Britton warns on H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Britton warns on H1 profits.

text.p: Britton Group Plc, the folding cartons and plastics packaging firm, said on Friday that it expects first half results will be some 30 percent lower than in 1996.
Britton also warned that it expects the second half of the year will be affected by adverse trading conditions. However, it still plans to make a modest increase in its dividend payout this year.
The firm made pretax profits of 11.1 million stg for the six months to June 30, 1996.
Britton's share price nearly halved in value on the back of the profits warning to stand at 44p, some 39-1/2p down on the day.
It blamed the poor trading on the continued strength of the pound against European currencies and on slower than expected sales in the U.S. cartons business.

Britton exports a significant proportion of its hygiene film business to continental Europe, where because of intense competition it has been unable to raise prices to compensate for sterling's strength.
